info.name: Hotel AI - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for all Hotel AI microservices.

## Services
- **hotel-inventory** (Go, port 8080) — Hotels, rooms, locations
- **booking-ops** (Go, port 8081) — Guests, bookings, availability
- **rag-pipeline** (Python, port 8091) — Vector search
- **llm-gateway** (Python, port 8090) — LLM proxy, prompts, usage
- **booking-assistant** (Python, port 8092) — LangGraph agent
- **knowledge-graph** (Python, port 8094) — GraphRAG search
- **multi-agent** (Python, port 8093) — Supervisor + workers

## Setup
1. `docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d`
2. Seed DB: `Get-Content infra/docker\seed.sql | docker exec -i docker-postgres-1 psql -U hotel -d hotel_inventory`
3. Import this collection into Postman
4. Set the `base_url_*` variables in the collection or environment

item.name: Flows
item.description: Pre-configured request sequences that exercise complete user journeys. Run steps in order — each step captures variables for the next.

item.name: 1. Complete Booking Lifecycle
item.description: Full journey: create guest -> search -> list rooms -> check availability -> book -> confirm -> check-in -> check-out -> verify. Exercises the entire booking state machine.

item.name: 2. Book & Cancel
item.description: Book a room, verify it's blocked, cancel the booking, verify the room is available again.

item.name: Step 8: Check Availability (should be true again)
3. Multi-Guest Booking
item.description: Two guests book different rooms at the same hotel. Tests guest isolation and hotel-level booking queries.

item.name: Step 4: Book Room A for Alice
Step 5: Book Room B for Bob
4. Room Availability Sweep
item.description: Check availability for all rooms at a hotel across multiple date ranges. Finds the best available room.
